experiment_template.research_question: Does an explicit resumable post-recycle rendering phase make shared-prefix branches behaviorally identical to uninterrupted projection before treatment?
stop_conditions: No thresholds, tasks, state content, repetition count or order change.
Only post-recycle phase restoration may change.
Stop on any ancestry, prompt-equivalence, phase or accounting mismatch.

records.falsifier: A resumed branch renders the unprojected pending exchange first, differs from an uninterrupted oracle beyond the declared state message, clears the phase before reservation, dispatches twice, loses receipt ancestry, or any branch again stops before candidate selection.
records.mechanism: At the first recycle, persist a phase that records generation, start index, history reference and the need to select from render_candidates. Pause without rendering. On branch resume, verify that phase and history, render the frozen candidate set once, select the first candidate under the unchanged boundary, then clear the phase only as part of durable dispatch reservation.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Persisting and restoring an explicit post-recycle candidate-rendering phase will let shared-prefix GLM-5.3-flash 8K ContextBench branches execute the same bounded projection path as uninterrupted episodes within cumulative model input plus output tokens.

dataset_refs: same exposed eight-task cohort for development; no reserved confirmation
experiment_template.research_question: Does a shared-prefix post-recycle fork distinguish causal ARE state benefit from pre-exposure model variance?
stop_conditions: Any snapshot or pre-treatment identity mismatch stops the pair.
No threshold or state-content change within the causal study.
Retain every repetition and never select a lucky seed.

records.falsifier: Branches differ before treatment, snapshot clone changes any bound state, control sees state, treatment lacks its declared presentation, repeated branch estimates remain too unstable for the fixed threshold, or the design cannot account every model input/output token.
records.mechanism: Run one common prefix until an actual recycle boundary, freeze its task, repository, delivery, ledger and prompt state, then clone it into control and treatment branches. Apply state only to treatment on the first post-boundary dispatch. Repeat branch pairs from exact prefix snapshots and randomize branch order; score treatment effects only after exposure.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Forking control and state from the same exact pre-recycle GLM-5.3-flash 8K trajectory and repeating post-boundary branches makes ContextBench state effects causally identifiable within cumulative model input plus output tokens.
